changelog:
Add an optional global entertainment channel profile
Load available channel IDs for the default profile from the selected area
Make blank per-user channel overrides inherit the global selection while explicit lists remain authoritative
Validate global channel IDs before saving and in the default Test Connection flow
Add regression coverage for global parsing, validation, persistence, runtime inheritance, and UI/API wiring
See CHANGELOG.md for the complete release history
description: Synchronize Philips Hue lights with your media playback in real-time.
name: Philips Hue Sync
overview: Adds support for real-time lighting synchronization with Philips Hue Entertainment Areas using the streaming DTLS API. Features cinema mode, scene restoration, per-user bridge mappings, playback performance, color scene, execution, channel, and restoration profiles, advanced color processing, and auto-reconnection.
